c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.name: House Valdrei
c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.label: The old blood, older than the maps that forgot them.
traits: Keepers of nine centuries of grudges, alphabetized
Their word, once given, outlives the giver
The candles bow slightly when one enters

c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.name: The Carmine Court
c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.label: Where appetite was refined into etiquette.
traits: Feeding is conducted as a formal dinner, with courses
They consider fangs a vulgarity; they use silver straws
Invitations arrive written in a red that never dries

c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.name: Order of the Pale Rose
c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.label: Sworn to remember what being mortal felt like.
traits: Each keeps one living flower, tended at terrible cost
They weep rarely, and save it, and mean it
Their oath: harm nothing that is already grieving

c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.name: The Gravebound
c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.label: They never left the churchyards that made them.
traits: They know every name on every stone, and visit
Earth from the home grave, worn in a locket
Patient the way only the buried learn to be

c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.name: Children of the Second Moon
c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.label: Turned beneath an eclipse; the night claims them twice.
traits: Their shadows arrive a half-second late
Tides answer them faintly, embarrassingly
They dream, which vampires are not supposed to do

c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.name: The Unnamed
c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.label: A bloodline so old its founder's name wore away.
traits: Records of them un-write themselves within a decade
Even elders lower their voices, unsure whom they lower them for
To join is to begin forgetting, starting with yourself

c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.name: House of Quiet Wings
c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.label: They took the bat not as a shape but as a philosophy.
traits: Arrive unannounced; leave unremembered
Sleep in congregations, dreaming in chorus
Consider echolocation a form of prayer

c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.name: The Last Parish
c65bc3b1-2f20-4302-ad22-ae15b1b752f7.label: Faithful still, to a church that would not have them.
traits: They keep the ruined chapels swept and candled
Sing the old services to empty pews at midnight
Believe, with terrible patience, in forgiveness

8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.name: Before the Bells
8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.label: Turned before church bells; your memories predate the calendar.
traits: You remember languages that are now only riverbeds
Modern nights feel loud, bright, and briefly amusing
You have outlived three separate ends of the world

8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.name: The Age of Plagues
8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.label: You rose from a century that buried its dead in haste.
traits: You are impossible to sicken and difficult to surprise
You keep herbs in your pockets out of old habit
You count doors in any room you enter. All of them

8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.name: The Candlelit Court
8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.label: Turned amid intrigue, in a palace that trusted no one.
traits: Fluent in fan-language, dueling etiquette, and poison
You can read a room by how its shadows sit
You still bow slightly when lying

8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.name: The Age of Powder and Silk
8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.label: The century of wigs, letters, and beautiful ruin.
traits: Your correspondence is legendary and largely threatening
You duel left-handed, out of courtesy
You have opinions about harpsichords. Strong ones

8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.name: The Gaslit Century
8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.label: Turned under gas-lamps, in the fog that hid so much.
traits: At home in cities that never quite see you
You read the penny dreadfuls about yourself, annotated
Fog follows you at a respectful distance

8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.name: The Century of Wires
8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.label: Turned as the world electrified and stopped looking up.
traits: Comfortable with telephones; suspicious of cameras
You learned to vanish into paperwork instead of mist
You still flinch at flashbulbs

8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.name: The Blue Glow
8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.label: Turned recently, mid-notification.
traits: Your last text remains unanswered, which is fine
You know the sun mostly as a screen-brightness setting
The elders find you baffling and faintly delicious

8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.name: Between Centuries
8a72f705-a0f2-4424-b161-cc4df4c8d09d.label: You genuinely cannot remember when it happened.
traits: Your memories argue with each other about dates
Every era feels like home and none of them are
Something was taken with the memory. You intend to find it

1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.name: The Mountain Keep
1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.label: A fortress the roads gave up reaching.
traits: Weather arrives here first and leaves last
The village below sets out lanterns, just in case
Seventy rooms; you use three; the rest remember

1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.name: The Ossuary Below
1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.label: You sleep among the politely stacked dead.
traits: The bones approve of you, in their quiet way
No one visits twice voluntarily
Excellent acoustics for melancholy

1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.name: The Ruined Nave
1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.label: A roofless church, open to the stars and nothing else.
traits: Rain falls where the altar was, softly, like applause
The ivy holds the walls up out of respect
Consecrated once; the ground still hums with it

1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.name: The River Palace
1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.label: City lights across the water, and you above them.
traits: The skyline performs for your windows nightly
Old money remembers your family; so do you: it was you
The river carries rumors to you by morning

1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.name: The Mausoleum Garden
1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.label: A modest marble house among the cypresses.
traits: Room for one, plus grief
The groundskeeper leaves flowers and asks nothing
Small, but the neighbors are quiet

1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.name: The Librarian's Tower
1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.label: Every shelf a century, every book a debt.
traits: The books reshelve themselves, resentfully
One volume is missing. You know which. So does it
Candle wax on everything; the books have made peace

1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.name: The Mirror Gallery
1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.label: A hall of frames that no longer bother showing you.
traits: Ninety mirrors, all of them politely vacant
Sometimes they show other rooms. You do not visit those
Guests find the gallery unsettling. Guests are correct

1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.name: Nowhere, and Everywhere
1a030a34-b65d-4617-b9a2-7a4bea298cb0.label: No lair at all; the night itself shelters you.
traits: You sleep in borrowed dark and owe no rent
Dawn has chased you across four countries. It has never won
Everything you own fits in one coat. The coat is ancient

05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.name: The Mist Shape
05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.label: You may come apart into weather.
traits: Keyholes are doors; drafts are highways
In mist you feel everything the fog touches
Reassembling takes concentration and vanity

05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.name: Command of Wings
05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.label: The bats attend you like a scattered congregation.
traits: A thousand small ears at your disposal
They bring you gossip, gnats, and warnings
In extremity, they will carry you. Undignified. Effective

05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.name: The Wolf's Accord
05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.label: The packs acknowledge you as winter acknowledges wolves.
traits: No wolf will harm you; several will insist on helping
You can borrow their senses on the hunt
Full moons feel like a letter from an old friend

05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.name: The Raven's Errand
05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.label: One black bird serves as your voice abroad.
traits: Delivers messages with judgmental punctuality
Remembers every face you ask it to
Refuses to work during heavy opera

05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.name: Mesmer's Voice
05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.label: Your suggestion outlives the conversation.
traits: Mortals agree with you, then agree they always had
Works best by candlelight; fails on the deaf and the furious
Overuse leaves you speaking in echoes for days

05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.name: The Still Heart
05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.label: You may be perfectly, convincingly dead.
traits: Undetectable to physicians, hunters, and tax collectors
Time passes strangely while still; bring a thought to keep
Waking is sudden and inconvenient for onlookers

05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.name: Red Alchemy
05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.label: You read blood the way scholars read letters.
traits: A single drop yields a life's rough table of contents
You can taste lies, illness, and inherited debts
Vintage snobbery is a genuine occupational hazard

05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.name: The Unopened Door
05dbc8f5-0376-4264-99e9-c234065366f2.label: Thresholds have stopped applying to you.
traits: No invitation required; doors sigh and permit you
Wards and salt lines file formal complaints, uselessly
Other vampires find this deeply unfair. It is

aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.name: The Empty Mirror
aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.label: Glass has forgotten you entirely.
traits: No reflection, no photographs, no proof
You paint self-portraits from memory; memory flatters
Barbers are a recurring logistical crisis

aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.name: The Counting Compulsion
aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.label: Scattered things demand tallying, and you must oblige.
traits: Spilled grain stops you as surely as any wall
You know the seed count of every rice sack in the county
Hunters know this. Clever ones carry millet

aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.name: The Silver Ache
aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.label: The moon's metal despises you.
traits: Silver burns cold and heals slow
You can smell it through velvet, through walls, through lies
Heirlooms are now a matter of careful gloves

aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.name: The Threshold Law
aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.label: You must be invited, every single time.
traits: Homes are fortresses; doormats are treaties
The words must be sincere; sarcasm bounces
You have become genuinely excellent company. You had to

aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.name: The Sun's Verdict
aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.label: Daylight has issued its sentence, and it is total.
traits: Even overcast noon feels like an accusation
Dawn is a wall of fire; you have seen it once. Once
You know every sunset time for the next forty years

aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.name: The Long Thirst
aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.label: No feeding has ever made you full.
traits: Hunger is a room you live in, not a visitor
Discipline is your entire personality now
The thirst grows patient when you do. It is winning

aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.name: The River's Refusal
aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.label: Running water will not have you.
traits: Bridges only, and only at the darkest hour
Rain is survivable; storms are humiliating
Ferrymen know you by your standing very still

aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.name: The Rose's Grief
aeabc3ce-16e0-4c03-a2a6-1b9597705a97.label: Living flowers die of your company.
traits: Gardens brown behind you like an apology
You press flowers now, before you can wilt them
One rose, once, refused to die. You think about it often

1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.name: The Patient Archivist
1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.label: A mortal scholar who found you in the footnotes.
traits: Catalogues your centuries with gentle rigor
Asks the questions no vampire dares to
You have not discussed what happens when they grow old. You will have to

1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.name: A Wolf Called Sorrow
1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.label: She was the last of her pack; now she is yours.
traits: Sleeps across your doorway like a drawn bolt
Distrusts everyone you should distrust, earlier
Howls only on the anniversary. Both of you know which one

1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.name: The Raven Matthias
1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.label: Elderly, opinionated, indispensable.
traits: Claims to have served three emperors; two confirm
Critiques your wardrobe by pulling threads
Knows every window in the city that never latches

1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.name: The Colony
1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.label: Four hundred small allies in the rafters.
traits: The evening departure is your calendar and your applause
They dislike your enemies before you do
The guano is a subject you have agreed not to discuss

1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.name: The Gravekeeper
1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.label: He buried you once, and apologized when you returned.
traits: Keeps your resting place immaculate and unlisted
Speaks to the dead as colleagues; they respond as such
Has dug precisely one grave he refuses to fill

1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.name: The Portrait That Watches
1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.label: Someone you loved, still paying attention.
traits: The eyes follow you with recognition, not menace
Speaks only in dreams, and only good advice
Restorers have offered to clean the painting. You have declined

1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.name: The Choir of Candles
1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.label: Small flames that gather where you grieve.
traits: They light themselves when you enter; you stopped asking why
In their flicker, sometimes, familiar profiles
Blowing one out feels like interrupting someone

1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.name: No One
1f42e048-cb9d-40af-9aed-102705fc0d44.label: You walk the centuries unaccompanied, by choice.
traits: Grief taught you the arithmetic of outliving
Your solitude is furnished, comfortable, and locked
Sometimes you set two glasses out anyway

b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.name: The Willing Cup
b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.label: Only from those who offer, and understand.
traits: Your table is set with candor and consent
The offered vintage is sweeter; everyone lies about why
Waiting lists exist. You find this mortifying

b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.name: The Sleeping City
b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.label: Sips from a thousand dreamers, harming none.
traits: No one wakes; everyone half-remembers a kind dream
The city is your cellar, gently rationed
You know the taste of every neighborhood by heart

b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.name: The Wretched Only
b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.label: You dine exclusively on the deserving.
traits: The city's alleys grew mysteriously safer
You read the papers to plan the menu
Justice and appetite agree more often than you expected

b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.name: The Cold Vintage
b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.label: Stored blood, taken warm from no one.
traits: Clinical, ethical, and faintly disappointing
Your cellar is labeled by year, type, and mood
Connoisseurs pity you. Their conscience does not

b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.name: The Beast's Table
b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.label: Animal blood, and the hunger managed.
traits: The forest tithes to you and is kept in return
Thin fare; your temper runs thinner with it
The deer have reached an understanding with you

b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.name: The Fasting Way
b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.label: You refuse the thirst outright, night after night.
traits: A discipline older and harder than any bloodline
Your restraint frightens other vampires profoundly
One slip would be catastrophic. You do not slip

b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.name: The Old Terror
b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.label: Fear itself sustains you; blood is optional theater.
traits: You feed on gasps, gooseflesh, and fleeing footsteps
Nobody is harmed; everybody is briefly improved
Halloween is, for you, a harvest festival

b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.name: The Chalice Trade
b37814dc-d3a0-429c-96e6-e999107361e3.label: A discreet arrangement with discreet institutions.
traits: Standing appointments, drawn curtains, no questions
The paperwork is impeccable and entirely false
You tip extravagantly in forgotten currencies

1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.name: The Family Signet
1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.label: A ring that remembers being kissed by kings.
traits: Seals letters that cannot be opened by the wrong hands
Old doors recognize it and unbolt
Wearing it, you dream the founder's dreams. They are cold

1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.name: A Grimoire of Small Doors
1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.label: A book whose pages open onto elsewhere.
traits: Each chapter is a place; the index is a map
New doors write themselves on the solstices
Page 41 is torn out. Something wanted to stay shut

1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.name: The Silver Parrying Dagger
1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.label: Painful to hold, and holds anything at bay.
traits: Turns hunter's steel and elder's claw alike
The grip is bound in leather; the ache seeps through anyway
Carrying your own bane makes a certain argument to enemies

1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.name: The Unemptying Chalice
1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.label: Wine, always; answers, sometimes.
traits: Never runs dry; never quite satisfies
Reflections in the wine show yesterday, accurately
It hums against silverware. The silverware hums back

1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.name: A Mirror That Remembers
1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.label: The one glass that never forgot your face.
traits: Shows you as you were, the year you were turned
Consulted sparingly; nostalgia bites deeper than hunters
Sometimes the reflection waves first

1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.name: The Reliquary Coffin
1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.label: Your first coffin, kept the way mortals keep cradles.
traits: Sleep within heals wounds the centuries left
Lined with earth from a country that no longer exists
It is, and you resent this, genuinely the best sleep

1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.name: A Rose From the Old Garden
1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.label: Cut the night you were turned; not dead yet.
traits: Neither wilts nor blooms; it waits, as you do
Its scent returns one specific evening completely
If it ever opens, something ends. You water it anyway

1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.name: The Candle That Never Gutters
1d827d9a-311a-4365-9a19-18f16e698fb5.label: Lit at your turning; burning still.
traits: Its flame leans toward true north and old friends
Blows out only in the presence of lies. Awkward at parties
By its light, the dead are briefly legible
